title: Research Analysis Bot
oneLiner: RAG-powered bot that performs gap analysis across multiple research papers.
objective: Process multiple research papers and questions to perform automated GAP analysis.
achievements: Applied pre/post-processing to optimize data for LLM inference.
Used RAG to improve accuracy, integrity, and grounding of answers.
Scaled to efficient batch processing for timely throughput.
Optimized similarity-search retrieval, lifting RAG accuracy to ~70-80%.
